decision_lens: Flags interactions that feel different thematically but produce identical mechanical incentives, and identifies missing archetypes.
focus: Whether the 22 interactions are mechanically distinct or whether several reduce to equivalent modifier patterns
name: fd-mechanical-distinctness
persona: A game designer who has analyzed hundreds of card and modifier systems for redundancy.
review_areas: Audit the document's internal count discrepancy: header says 19 but tables list 22
Identify interactions that reduce to the same +X% effectiveness in domain Y pattern
Check for unused InteractionEffects fields (coalition_trust_mod only used once?)
Evaluate whether conflicts are mechanically distinct from each other
Identify missing archetypes: stabilizer, specialist, coalition-only value
Check reckless_actor deployment speed for implementability
success_hints: Each interaction produces a player decision no other interaction produces
task_context: Shadow Work is a geopolitical simulation with 31 personality facets. Interactions are meant to be flavor on top of primary systems, not dominant drivers.
